QUICK INTEGRATION GUIDE:

ENDPOINT

Send POST request with: api_key, action, product_id, duration, quantity (1-100). Bulk success response me keys[], quantity aur total_price milta hai. (Device-bound / V1 products ke liye android_id bhejna zaroori hai, normal direct V2 products ke liye android_id ki zaroorat nahi hai).

RESELLER
API CODE
ℹ IMPORTANT CONFIGURATION CHECKLIST:
  1. PID Verification: Apne bot ya panel me table se dekh kar sahi PID (Product ID) dalein.
  2. Duration Name: Duration Name exact wahi bhejiye jo table me dikh raha hai (e.g. 1 Hours, 3 Hours, 1 Day).
  3. Bulk Buy: quantity me jitni keys chahiye bhejiye (1-100). Response ki keys array ko integrate karein; single compatibility ke liye key bhi first key deta hai.
  4. Android ID System: Agar product [Device Lock / V1] hai tabhi android_id bhejiye; direct key (V2) me bina android_id ke key ban jaati hai.
